headline: The Philippines and Australia strengthen joint military deterrence at ASEAN summit
summary: Southeast Asian leaders opened their annual summit in the Philippine capital Manila on Sunday. During three days, world leaders are expected to focus on trade, energy and conflict – including the war in Iran. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Bangkok Tommy Walker.
